instruction: Studio photograph, medium shot. A group of cheerleaders stands in a row against a white background. From left to right: the curly-haired woman (R1) is partially visible on the left edge; the purple-haired woman (R7) stands with eyes closed; the short black-haired woman (R4) stands looking forward; the dark brown-haired woman (R9) looks forward; and the long dark-haired woman (R6) stands on the right. They wear white 'Warsaw Mets' t-shirts and white skirts, holding metallic orange pom-poms at their hips. The lighting is bright and clean, highlighting their confident poses.
